Coca-Cola new entrants threat GLP-1 private label Poppi Celsius soda competition 2026

findings.claim: 10-K FY2025 將新進入者與零售商自有品牌列為競爭挑戰，並稱主要競爭對手之一為百事。
findings.excerpt: Our competitive challenges include strong competitors in all geographic regions; in many countries, a concentrated retail sector with powerful buyers able to freely choose among Company products, products of competitive beverage suppliers and individual retailers’ own store or private-label beverage brands; new industry entrants;

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因子：競爭可能限制公司維持或提升份額的能力，並壓抑定價。
findings.excerpt: Our ability to maintain or gain share of sales in the global market or in regional or local markets may be limited as a result of actions by competitors. Competitive pressures may cause the Company and our bottling partners to reduce prices we charge customers

competitive_share_entrants.note: 搜尋摘要稱 2026 財測上調、非酒精即飲飲料價值份額成長，但未讀到頁面原文，列為 clues；Simply Pop 與 Poppi（被百事收購）的新進入者資訊亦僅有搜尋摘要。

clues.claim: Coca-Cola 報告全球單位箱量成長 5%、北美持平，並在非酒精即飲飲料取得價值份額成長，上調 2026 EPS 展望。
Coca-Cola 推出 Simply Pop 益生元汽水，對標 Olipop 與 Poppi。
